_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct and 5 Nov) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (community sources).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

skillBooks.text: Skill book counts (a/b on a skill's Upgrade button) are your shared stock of that book type, not progress saved on that skill. Each rarity has its own books: Epic heroes share Epic books, Mythic heroes share Mythic books, so books spent on one Epic hero are gone for every other Epic hero. Book type names are read from the icons.

redeemShards.text: The Redeem count on a hero's promotion screen is a shared stock of shards per rarity: Epic heroes share Epic Redeem shards, Mythic heroes share Mythic ones, so shards redeemed for one hero are gone for the others of that rarity. How many hero shards one Redeem shard gives is not recorded.

The screen shows no names; left to right they look like Jabel, Chenko, Seth, Quinn and Diana, and these are exactly the five heroes whose own 5 Nov screens show Lv 64 without the Drill Camp message (Olive shows Lv 63 and Edwin Lv 59), so the identification is firm. recommendations.what: Howard: swap the Rare Stonewall Greaves (+24) for Seth's Epic Praetorian's Greaves (+20)

Seth's Epic Praetorian's Greaves, now +20 (5 Nov), beat them on every stat (38,850; ATK +96, HP +945; +13.20%), and Seth is a gathering hero in no line-up. Howard's other three pieces (Epic +21) already beat Seth's (+20), so only the boots move. Howard's Epic gloves since 5 Nov are a separate pair: Seth still wears his own. Howard's freed Greaves (+24) then go to Forrest, the infantry hero in the Be march, in place of his +17 pair, and Seth takes Forrest's +17 pair so no slot is left empty.

recommendations.what: Promotions: redeem 20 of the 24 Epic shards for Diana's Tier 2 now; keep the 36 Mythic shards for Jabel's 4★ (needs 64); Rare: Olive is closest to 4★ (needs 24)
recommendations.why: Redeem shards are a shared stock per rarity (confirmed by you on 27 Oct). Since 27 Oct, Diana reached 4★ Tier 1, Quinn 4★ Tier 1, Howard, Chenko and Gordon 4★, and Jabel 3★ Tier 5 (5 Nov screens). Epic: the stock is 24. Diana needs 20 for Tier 2 (80 / 100), so the stock covers it now: +36,080 base power and Archer Attack and Defense +81.28% → +86.24%. Amane's 3★ also needs 20 (20 / 40): +21,920 base power, +5.80% Archer Attack and Defense, and it lifts her Lv. 3 caps (Tri-Phalanx +15% → +20% squad Attack, a rally-joiner skill; Exorcism +30% → +40% infirmary healing speed). The 24 shards cover only one of the two; Diana stays first because she leads the Be march and is in both Arena squads, while Amane is in no combat line-up, only the Gat gathering preset (inferred). Quinn needs 68 for Tier 2 (32 / 100; +36,080 and +6.32%), Howard 98 for Tier 1 (2 / 100; +32,560 and +6.31%), Chenko 92 and Gordon 95 for the same step (8 / 100 and 5 / 100), and Yeonwoo 27 for 3★ Tier 1 (13 / 40; +18,880 and +4.51%), so none of them fits the stock. Fahd reached 3★ by 5 Nov and needs 23 for Tier 1 (17 / 40; +18,880 and +4.51%), but he is in no line-up. Mythic: Jabel needs 64 for 4★ (36 / 100) and the stock is 36, so she cannot promote yet; keep the Mythic shards for her rather than Helga (0 / 5 on 5 Nov) or Saul (2★ Tier 5 by 5 Nov, 0 / 40 to 3★), who are in no line-up. Her 4★ adds +46,700 base power and lifts Gallant Throw's Lv. 4 cap ("ascend to 4-Star"), and presumably the caps on Persistence and Youthful Rage too (inferred). Rare: the stock is 4 (5 Nov screens). All four Rare heroes are now 3★ Tier 5, and each 4★ gives +30,355 base power and +5.22% Attack and Defense for its troop type: Olive needs 24 (76 / 100), Forrest 41 (59 / 100), Seth 61 (39 / 100) and Edwin 93 (7 / 100; he reached Tier 5 by 5 Nov). Olive is the closest; Forrest is the only one in a combat preset (the Be march), and Seth and Edwin are in the Gat gathering preset. Their gathering skills at Lv. 4 presumably need 4★ for Lv. 5 (Forrest's and Seth's say so).

recommendations.what: Troops: the Infantry goal is met (Att is 50% Infantry on Tier VIII); optionally test the guides' 50 / 20 / 30 in Att
recommendations.why: By 5 Nov all troops are Tier VIII (Elite): Infantry 45,474 (33.7%), Cavalry 46,298 (34.3%), Archers 43,180 (32.0%), 134,952 in all. A full march now holds 88,880, so 50% is 44,440, and your Att preset uses exactly that: 44,440 Infantry, 26,664 Cavalry and 17,776 Archers (50 / 30 / 20). Community guides most often give 50% Infantry / 20% Cavalry / 30% Archers for attacks and rallies (some say 45 / 25 / 30). Your 30% Cavalry may suit Att, because Jabel, a Cavalry hero, is its strongest hero (inferred); the guides' mix would move 8,888 from Cavalry to Archers, where Quinn's Archer bonuses apply. Neither choice is shown to be better in the game.

recommendations.what: Skill books: next 50 Epic Conquest Books to Gordon's Trash Talk, next 50 Epic Expedition Manuals to Howard's Joint Defense
recommendations.why: Skill books are a shared stock per type, so each 50 books buys one Lv. 3 → 4 upgrade for one hero. The ranking puts first the skills that help every troop or hero (not just the hero himself) on heroes used in the most line-ups. Conquest Books upgrade march (expedition) skills: Howard's Defenders' Edge reached Lv. 4 by 27 Oct and his Weaken by 5 Nov, so Gordon's Trash Talk is next: it raises every squad's Attack from 15% to 20% in the Be march and Barricade 2. Expedition Manuals upgrade Arena (exploration) skills: Howard's Shielded Strike reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov (Lv. 5 costs 75); Joint Defense is still next, because it raises Defense for all heroes from 10% to 12.5% and Howard is in the front of both Arena squads. Mythic: Jabel's Persistence and Youthful Rage reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov and presumably wait for her 4★ (inferred), so there is no Mythic target until Jabel's 4★. Amane's three exploration skills went Lv. 2 → 3 by 5 Nov (30 books each) and now wait for her 3★. Chenko's Stand of Arms (her rally-joiner skill) also reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov: see the rally suggestion.

recommendations.what: Long term: Mythic shards and books to Jabel first; Epic investment to Howard, Quinn and Diana, plus Chenko or Yeonwoo as the rally joiner; Helga and Saul last for combat
recommendations.why: Jabel is your only Mythic hero in the combat line-ups (Att, both Arena squads, Barricade 1), and community guides call her the easiest Generation 1 Mythic to build without paying; she reached Tier 5 by 5 Nov and is 64 shards from 4★ (36 / 100). Guides rank Amadeus as the strongest Generation 1 hero, but he is not recruited (0 / 20) and they say he mostly comes from paid packs. Guides call Helga pay-to-win and rank Saul lowest of the Generation 1 Mythics in combat; Saul's value to you is Resourceful (now Lv. 3: +9% construction speed, −9% cost). Among your Epic heroes, a 2026 list rates Howard and Quinn highest and Diana for beast hunting. Guides also say Generation 2 heroes (Zoe infantry, Hilde cavalry, Marlin archer) arrive around kingdom day 37–50 and Generation 3 around day 105–120; one guide advises building Jabel until Generation 3 rally heroes arrive. You have none of the Generation 2 heroes yet (28 Oct), which suggests they have not reached your kingdom, though it is also possible they are out but not yet earned (inferred).
steps: Mythic shards: Jabel to 4★ (36 / 100 on 5 Nov, needs 64; 36 Mythic Redeem in stock) before Helga (0 / 5) or Saul (0 / 40 to 3★).
Mythic books: Jabel's Youthful Rage and Persistence reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov; their next level presumably waits for her 4★ (inferred). Not Saul's.
Amadeus: collect his shards from free events when offered (0 / 20 on 22 Oct); buying him only makes sense if you plan to spend.
Epic shards and books: Diana, Quinn and Howard first, then the rally joiner (Chenko or Yeonwoo); Fahd and Amane are in no combat line-up.

Generation 2: you have no Zoe, Hilde or Marlin yet (28 Oct), so Generation 1 heroes are still your best options; check the Hero Roulette and Hall of Heroes events for them, and when one appears, ask for an updated plan.

recommendations.what: Test a combat hero instead of Forrest in the Be (beast) march

Diana (lead: -18% stamina, +60% hunting march speed) and Gordon (+15% squad Attack and Health) stay. Helga is the closest swap: she is also infantry, so the troop mix stays the same, and she adds Echoes of Valhalla (+10% squad Attack) and Oath of Guardian (16% chance to halve damage taken). Her hero power is lower (306,455 vs Forrest's 438,984 on 5 Nov), so test it before keeping it.
